name: Roseau Centre
tagline: The grid between the river and the sea
description: Dominica's small capital, a compact grid of narrow streets and wooden verandahed houses between the Roseau river and the sea, with the market at the northern end and the Botanic Gardens behind. It can be crossed on foot in fifteen minutes.
bestFor: Anyone without a vehicle who needs banks, the market and the ferry
pros: The Saturday market is excellent and cheap
Ferries to Guadeloupe and Martinique leave from here
cons: Busy and hot on cruise days

name: Morne Bruce
description: The hill immediately above Roseau, reached by a steep road or a set of steps from the Botanic Gardens, with views over the capital and the sea and a scattering of houses and guesthouses. It is cooler than the town below and considerably quieter.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a view and cooler air near the capital
pros: Views over Roseau and the Caribbean
Ten minutes down to the centre
cons: The walk back up is genuinely steep
Nothing in the way of shops

name: Trafalgar and Laudat
description: Two villages in the mountains above Roseau, Trafalgar beside its twin waterfalls and Laudat higher up at the start of the walks to Boiling Lake, Freshwater Lake and the Valley of Desolation. This is where Dominica's hiking actually begins.
bestFor: Hikers who want the Morne Trois Pitons trails at the door
pros: Trafalgar Falls and the hot springs
Trailheads for Boiling Lake and the lakes
cons: Thirty minutes up a steep road from Roseau
Very wet, even by Dominican standards

name: Portsmouth
tagline: The second town, in the north
description: Dominica's northern town on Prince Rupert Bay, with the Indian River boat trips, the Cabrits National Park and Fort Shirley above it, and Ross University's medical campus giving it an international student population. It is the yachting centre of the island.
bestFor: Anyone wanting a calmer bay, a student population and cheaper rent
pros: Cabrits National Park and Fort Shirley
The best anchorage and yachting scene on the island
cons: An hour from Roseau on winding roads
